description: Capability for the main window and every satellite (`sat-*`), which draw the same title bar and therefore need the same window controls. Note the four maximize/restore commands: the title bar's maximize button doesn't use `toggle_maximize`, because on undecorated Windows that grows the window but doesn't put the rectangle back — `src/lib/windowControls.ts` restores by hand, and needs `maximize`, `unmaximize`, `set_size` and `set_position`. `core:default` grants none of them, so leaving them out has every click on the button rejected before it reaches the window.
